material.description: Stated request (commit d302127): recall reports index convergence; partial digests resume. Possible real problem: memory_sync budgets (memory_sync.*_budget_ms) are smaller than one full sync pass, so each dispatch restarts from the same point and the index never converges; reporting convergence only makes the stall visible. Check: record the partial digest across repeated dispatches and whether its cursor advances. Witness: two consecutive recall replies showing the cursor or processed-count moving forward.

material.description: Stated request (commit 5f11f1e): bump rs-plugkit for the allowOutsideRoot ancestor grant. Possible real problem: the dispatch cwd resolves to a directory whose git toplevel differs from the project the caller meant (a submodule or a nested repo), so the grant lets an out-of-root path through instead of correcting the root. Check: for each caller that triggered the grant, compare the cwd, the git toplevel and the .gm directory it resolved to. Witness: one dispatch from a submodule cwd through the real verb showing which .gm tree it read or wrote.
material.title: XY check: allowOutsideRoot ancestor grant may hide a wrong project root
material.witness: REFUTED. The grant does not re-root: the refused read from cwd rs-plugkit names root C:\dev\gm\rs-plugkit (dispatch 1791850569252-500-598ef7b534462833, out-file rs-plugkit/.gm/exec-spool/out/fs_read-...-1791850560085-130.json); the opt-in read of C:/dev/gm/AGENTS.md is ok under the same root (dispatch 1791850572034-500-b7bf1ea5075a8267). The dispatch was made from a submodule cwd, so it is in rs-plugkit's ledger, not this project's; the binding is the four-field form, whose exit code 0 means the probe ran to a reply, not that the verb returned ok. callers outside_root_read_granted -> project_path_rejection only. Witness-log line appended. Residual gap (success reply has no root echo) filed as XY-ALLOWOUTSIDEROOT-SUCCESS-NO-ROOT-ECHO (1791850821209-500-b44aa29965964e69). Receipts .gm/receipts/XY-ALLOWOUTSIDEROOT-MASKS-WRONG-ROOT/01-08.

material.description: Ubiquitous Language (P2). The word pin means a submodule pin in AGENTS.md and scripts/triage/check-pins.sh, but gm-mcp/src uses bare pin for a different thing, the sha256 local-build pin (cli.js:163-170 pin-local-build and unpin-local-build with locals pin and pinPath; release-bridge.js:17 RUNNER_PIN_FILE). The self-update module already says LOCAL_BUILD_PIN_FILE, localBuildPinPath and pinLocalBuild. Change in scope gm-mcp/src/cli.js and gm-mcp/src/release-bridge.js: rename the bare pin and pinPath locals to localBuildPin and localBuildPinPath, and RUNNER_PIN_FILE to RUNNER_LOCAL_BUILD_PIN_FILE, so the code always carries the qualifier the submodule meaning lacks. On-disk file names are unchanged. Witness: grep for bare pin or pinPath identifiers in gm-mcp/src/cli.js returns none, and gm-mcp/src/cli.js self-update-status still prints the local_build_pin_path key.

material.description: Ubiquitous Language (P2). Suppressing automatic bundle/runner updates is named no-self-update in the on-disk marker and env (NO_SELF_UPDATE_FILE 'gm-mcp-server.no-self-update' and RUNNER_FREEZE_FILE 'agentplug-runner.no-self-update', GM_MCP_NO_SELF_UPDATE and RUNNER_FREEZE_ENV), in AGENTS.md, and in the self-update verb name. The code names the same concept freeze: selfUpdateFreezeReason and bridgeFreezeReason in gm-mcp/src/self-update.js:48 and gm-mcp/src/release-bridge.js:164, the frozen locals at self-update.js:219 and release-bridge.js:294, and the frozen_by / 'freeze state' output in self-update.js:153 and cli.js:218. Decision recorded: no-self-update is the ubiquitous term because it names the marker and env the operator types. Change: rename the code identifiers to noSelfUpdate* (selfUpdateFreezeReason -> selfUpdateSuppressedReason is NOT the choice; use noSelfUpdateReason, bridgeNoSelfUpdateReason, and frozen -> suppressed) in gm-mcp/src/self-update.js, gm-mcp/src/release-bridge.js and the cli.js help and status text. The wire field frozen_by is a user-visible output key and is NOT renamed here; that choice is a mutable for the user. Witness: grep for freeze in gm-mcp/src returns only frozen_by, and node gm-mcp/src/cli.js self-update-status prints the same reason text as before.

material.detail: Root cause (verified live, not the shell-out hypothesis): walk_posix in rs-plugkit/crates/plugkit-core/src/code_index.rs is a pure in-process walk over host_fs_readdir. On C:\dev\aloopprime, fs_readdir {"path":"."} lists an entry named `nul`, but fs_stat {"path":"./nul"} returns not-found, because nul is a reserved DOS device name Win32 will not open in any directory. With checked == true walk_posix did `return Err("file stat failed for {next}")`, propagating as file_enumeration_failed / complete:false / enumeration_complete:false -- so one unstattable entry costs the whole project its index and every codeinsight call answers 'symbol index refresh is incomplete' forever. FIX IS WRITTEN BUT NOT LANDED: committed as rs-plugkit 8395d5ebadd008c2c29810024e5a80d7f60248ab (one path, crates/plugkit-core/src/code_index.rs) -- unstattable entries are now skipped and recorded (FileEnumeration::skipped_unstattable surfaced by codeinsight_index) instead of fatal, and Windows reserved device names (con/prn/aux/nul/com1..com9/lpt1..lpt9, case-insensitive, with or without extension, plus trailing-dot/space) are pre-filtered only when the host cwd is Windows-shaped so a POSIX aux.rs still indexes. Compile-verified: cargo build -p rs-plugkit --release --target wasm32-wasip1 --features slim exit 0 (5,656,887-byte wasm). NOT DONE: the wasm was never installed to ~/.agentplug/plugins/gm.wasm, so no live codeinsight verification ran -- reconfirmed 2026-10-10 that C:\dev\aloopprime codeinsight_index {"action":"status"} still returns complete:false / 'file stat failed for ./nul'. PUSH BLOCKED, DO NOT FORCE: rs-plugkit main is not a fast-forward of origin/main and another writer has crates/plugkit-core/src/config_sync.rs dirty with 5082 staged deletions under .agentplug-kv/codeinsight-edges/ -- pulling over that clobbers in-flight work. Landing sequence: wait for that writer, pull, push, rebuild+install gm.wasm, then re-run codeinsight_index sync and codeinsight callers on aloopprime.

material.detail: Measured 2026-10-11 on c:/dev/gm by lane aaf4e517 (row gm-config-refresh-degraded-silent-nested-copy-cause, fix committed as c0ee16ee40277855db7f87bf86d0442231e6ef4b): git_push {rev:"c0ee16ee..."} failed verbatim "push of explicit source ref 'c0ee16ee40277855db7f87bf86d0442231e6ef4b' to main failed because the remote moved ... Recover with exactly: git_pull {branch:"main"} to fast-forward past the remote's new commit, then git_push {rev:"HEAD"}", and the recovery it names then refused verbatim "worktree or index is not clean, so a pull could clobber uncommitted changes -- refusing exactly as before. Dirty tracked files: .gm/prd.yml, skills/gm-orchestrate/SKILL.md, skills/gm-prd/SKILL.md, ...". The served recovery is unreachable in the normal case: every lane keeps .gm/prd.yml dirty (rows append continuously, and a path-scoped commit cannot include it without allow_foreign_rows), so pull is refused exactly when the recovery commands it. Acceptance: on a repo whose remote moved and whose dirty set is lane-owned, the served recovery ends with the sha pushed -- either git_pull fast-forwards past a dirty set it never touches (stash/restore), or the recovery names the clean-tree step first (path-scoped git_finalize of the dirty tracked files, .gm/prd.yml with allow_foreign_rows) before the pull. Witness: on a repo with a moved remote, dirty .gm/prd.yml and one edited skill, running the served recovery verbatim ends with the sha pushed and ci-status read on it, not with a second refusal.

No README, AGENTS.md or SKILL.md text names the job, its scope (history, not only the working diff), or what must happen when the heuristic misses. Done when the job's boundary is stated, and a witness shows a seeded credential shape blocked before push.

material.body:
Claim (DBC, precondition on verb calls): arguments must satisfy the verb schema, and a call carrying keys outside the schema is refused. Witness: gm-mcp/src/codemode.js:15 validates with z.object(tool.inputSchema), which strips unknown keys by default, so a misspelled field is dropped with no error. Live check, session gm-goal-w4-DBC: codesearch with bogus_field:1 was admitted and searched; codesearch with cwd:12345 was refused ("cwd: expected string"). Type checks hold; unknown-key rejection does not. Fix is not a one-line change: .strict() would reject the session_id and cwd defaults the codemode contract forwards to verbs whose schema omits them. Needs a test on that path and a bundle rebuild (gm-mcp src and committed bundle together).

material.acceptance: (1) a version file whose content carries a leading U+FEFF is read as its semver after the BOM is stripped; (2) it is never classified as a local-dev sideload; (3) a BOM'd .version no longer freezes guest upgrades (reconcileGuest proceeds to upgrade); (4) a genuinely non-semver marker (e.g. 'dev', 'local', 'abc') still classifies as local-dev-sideload; (5) live witness (id, hash, ts) from a real dispatch reproducing the freeze with a BOM'd .version in a scratch home and never touching C:\Users\user\.agentplug, then showing fixed code reading it as semver.
material.subject: BOM'd plugins/<name>.version freezes guest upgrades as a fake local-dev sideload
material.text: Live defect 2026-10-10: C:\Users\user\.agentplug\plugins\gm.version bytes are \u{feff}0.1.1520 (leading U+FEFF). The agentplug-runner plugin-update poll refuses it as 'not recognized X.Y.Z semver' and writes gm.local-dev-sideload.json (installed_marker "\u{feff}0.1.1520"); gm-mcp/src/release-bridge.js reconcileGuest then returns {outcome:'skipped', reason:'local-dev-sideload'}, so gm.wasm is never upgraded from AnEntrypoint/plugkit-bin again. Live daemon stuck on 0.1.1520 while plugkit-bin is at 0.1.1539, silently. Same silent-BOM class as row gm-reverify-silent-on-unparsable-prd (spoint orch b186): a BOM turns a live upgrade path into a permanent silent no-op mislabelled as an intentional developer sideload. Fix at source on BOTH the Rust runner (agentplug/crates/agentplug-runner/src/download.rs) and the JS bridge (gm-mcp/src/release-bridge.js, gm-mcp/src/self-update.js, anything reading .version): strip a leading U+FEFF before any semver test/compare of an installed version file. Keep real sideload detection intact: a genuinely non-semver marker stays a sideload.

material.body: Measured 2026-10-14 by session gm-drain-w1-131 on fixture r131-witness-1791958416981. After git_pull merges a diverged remote, the served step 'git_push {rev:"HEAD"}' (rs-plugkit/crates/plugkit-core/src/wasm_dispatch/verbs/git.rs remote_moved refusal, ~line 1614) returns gate_denied: 'source_ref HEAD is symbolic ... 2 unnamed commits'. Auto-recovery in the same path succeeds, so the verbatim step is the friction. Acceptance: the remote_moved recovery text names the sha to publish (the head_after of the pull, or the pushed rev) and that verbatim sequence ends with the sha pushed. Witness: diverged fixture with dirty non-overlapping paths; git_pull then the served step 2 text, ending with remote main equal to the local sha, not a gate_denied.
